x69b535bf58: Market research for Hannah and the Manna AI founding team
x7e13909124: Start at **Kwame Nkrumah Circle, Accra**, alongside an independent phone seller and a repairer. Follow one used handset from the first inspection through payment and, if it comes back, the final remedy. The second visit should be a bale opening at Kantamanto and the tailor or downstream trader who receives the lower grades. Reserve Kumasi’s Adum for a comparison with Circle. The Ghana connection reduces the cost of learning. The strongest demand remains to be discovered.
xbc9485ac80: Five findings that change the investigation
x22902bc246: **1 · Buyers already pay for trust.** A researcher met a customer who travelled 7½ hours and expected the same journey home for a warranty repair in Kumasi. The phone had cost GHS 400 and the outbound fare was GHS 35, with the same amount expected for the return. The choice reveals the value he placed on trusted parts and the cost of redeeming a promise. It is one historical case. [Lu’s field account](https://www.academia.edu/74513903/Mobile_phone_repair_in_Ghana_Comparing_three_approaches)
xe2b2f269e7: **2 · Accra already has people who check, refer and repair.** A field mapping counted 127 repair centres at Circle and documented repairers sharing expertise through WhatsApp. A third party must show what it can resolve that this network cannot. [Accra cluster study](https://ugspace.ug.edu.gh/server/api/core/bitstreams/3667fbcb-eb82-46fa-a288-174fec607d8a/content)
x7527c45719: **3 · Clothing quality risk is borne before the customer arrives.** Kantamanto traders commit cash to sealed bales. A 2026 study in Greater Kumasi found that material classified as waste still generated resale value. Track pieces, weight, time and cash separately. [Kantamanto research design](https://grp.cepr.org/pedl/projects/waste-and-quality-uncertainty-imported-secondhand-clothing-markets) [Kumasi study](https://agris.fao.org/search/en/records/69b96281ce5e0ae4f8789fce)
x67953156b6: **4 · Refill already has a price and a practical obstacle.** Jibu lists an 18.9 L bottle at GHS 95 new and GHS 22 for a refill. An Accra customer separately recorded a different supplier declining another brand’s empties. Route density and bottle compatibility are testable reasons for a missed refill. [Jibu Ghana](https://jibuco.com/gh) [Customer account](https://www.quartey.com/writing/bottled-water-dispenser-delivery-accra)
x0906accd5b: **5 · Supply can recover faster than a trader’s cash flow.** Ghana’s recorded worn-article imports rose to USD 115.28m in 2025. A year after the Kantamanto fire, traders described weak footfall and insufficient capital to reopen. [WITS](https://wits.worldbank.org/trade/comtrade/en/country/GHA/year/2025/tradeflow/Imports/partner/ALL/product/630900) [GNA interviews](https://gna.org.gh/2026/01/one-year-after-fire-kantamanto-traders-lament-decline-in-business/)

An easy mistake is to treat customs value as shoppers’ spending. The result most likely to reverse this order is how many recent phone disputes a shop could have avoided or resolved more cheaply, multiplied by who would actually pay to do so.

xe10a6471cc: **Kumasi, October 2019.** Akwasi had bought a Tecno handset in Adum six months earlier for GHS 400. To use the warranty he travelled from Enchi overnight and expected to pay GHS 70 for both bus legs. Transport alone was 17.5% of the original handset price. His account attributes the trip to distrust of available local parts. It shows willingness to incur expense for one trusted repair. It cannot tell us typical willingness to pay for a certificate, or what bus fare costs today. [Original field account](https://www.academia.edu/74513903/Mobile_phone_repair_in_Ghana_Comparing_three_approaches)
x0e17c21b85: **Kantamanto, 2022/23 field baseline.** A researcher observed a buyer pay GHS 90 for jeans and GHS 15 to shorten and alter them. On this transaction the buyer spent GHS 105 to obtain usable trousers, with 14.3% going toward fit. A remote listing would have to preserve access to fitting or beat the time and money saved by obtaining it on site. One observed receipt-equivalent is more informative about who captures value than a national bale count. The source recorded observation, without a merchant ledger. x6e6c5b8fe1: **Street stall and trusted trader.** The buyer can test, bargain and find the same person tomorrow. The seller can refer a problem to a neighbouring technician. A relative may pay or refer the buyer, while another person uses the item. Informal arrangements complicate refunds when the acquaintance or stall moves. Recruit through associations and independently on the pavement. [Field mapping](https://ugspace.ug.edu.gh/server/api/core/bitstreams/3667fbcb-eb82-46fa-a288-174fec607d8a/content)
x8a54b4d414: **Group, classified, branded counter.** A social group extends an existing network. A classified exposes more prices while the stranger still has to inspect, pay and collect. A counter can publish return terms, but travel, data, waiting, proof of purchase and exclusions determine their practical value. One Accra seller advertises seven-day support subject to inspection. Ask the person who declined the purchase which of these mattered. [COLE policy](https://colephonesghana.com/) [Regional buyer remedies](https://badili.ke/pages/warranty)
xec999db849: **How people will actually respond.** Offer a paper or voice option in the language each person chooses, using Twi, Ga or English with a local interviewer as appropriate. Record cash alongside MoMo. A 2024 Accra field study conducted many informal-sector interviews in Twi. The census permits comparisons by district, age, gender and device type; it does not measure whether an individual could spare data that day. [Accra research methods](https://rgs-ibg.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1111/geoj.70061) [GSS ICT tables](https://statsbank.statsghana.gov.gh/pxweb/en/PHC%202021%20StatsBank/PHC%202021%20StatsBank__ICT/)

x8f62a27221: **Follow the handset.** A household or importer supplies the dealer. A local swap makes the seller of the old handset a buyer of the replacement, with a cash top-up or credit. The shop inspects, sets a purchase price and holds inventory. A technician verifies charge, connectivity, screen, cameras and owner-authorised release of account locks, and discloses replaced parts. Buyer compares, negotiates, inspects at pickup and pays. Date the receipt and explain who handles a fault. If the item comes back, log inspection, remedy, time, replaced component and onward sale, parts recovery or handover. The paths are observed in aggregate, not traced for one serial-numbered unit. x58ff2d0cf7: Cash at risk belongs to the trader who has to sell this particular mix of sizes, styles and defects
xa2512a6515: **From exporter to wearer.** A sorter packs articles by description or grade. An importer and wholesaler can sell smaller lots through intermediaries. A retailer commits funds or takes credit before inspecting individual pieces. At opening, sellers sort first selections, clean or steam items, set prices, discount slower stock and refer alterations to tailors. Some pieces reach another trader, are given away or sold for low-value uses. Some ultimately enter the waste stream. Porters, including kayayei, move bales. The records needed for a service sit across these actors, each with a different claim on the proceeds. The report’s prose gives GHS 1,502 at the low end; its table and the arithmetic yield GHS 1,522. Selling prices were potential and the observed purchase was one bale. Both inputs are sensitivity assumptions. A start-up taking a booking fee has a different margin from the water producer. Ask the distributor for a route manifest, actual contribution and three days of rejected empties.
